input.conversion: Native pixel crop, 8-bit sRGB display RGB. No resize or manual structure masks.
input.name: Tarantula core · native SMASH crop

target: Entire frozen display photograph, including unresolved stars. No point-source subtraction or gas-membership claim.

model.projectedScaleNote: Native SMASH crop width derived from the existing authored LMC photo/simulation registration; not a matched gas-cloud registration.
model.localFrame: Isolated crop centred on its image; identity orientation and zero origin are lab framing, not a celestial placement.

priors.selection: Each connected cross-scale family selects one strongest sampled stellar-density Z mode; separated modes are never averaged.

diagnostics.opticalTransfer: RGBA uses photo-master RGB×alpha and shared-opacity mapping; RGB+luminance uses the supplied normalized intensity multiplier.
claimLimitations: Depth and thickness are deterministic display-model priors, not measured gas geometry.
The stellar density is a weak placement prior and does not identify corresponding gas clouds.
A preserved reference projection does not validate side or oblique views.
Occlusion, extinction and calibrated photometry are unsupported.

columns.interpretation: Numerical reference-column and Z-integration gate before image quantization. Does not validate segmentation, perspective views, or physical depth.

limitations: Research controls only: automatic extraction is not yet accepted for production gas geometry.
All three targets retain the exact same display photograph, including foreground stars and intrinsic knots; no stellar-membership separation.
Broad is an isolated finite-depth control, not a reproduction of the whole-LMC stellar-column model.
Unknown depth, thickness, and affine family tilt are authored priors; a correct front projection cannot determine them.
The 3D object uses a local laboratory frame; it is not placed in the production celestial scene.
No extinction, radiative transfer, physical gas density, or calibrated photometry is inferred.
